script: This team went from being one of the worst in the NBA to winning a championship just two years later. In 1997, the Spurs finished 20-62 after David Robinson missed most of the season with an injury. But that terrible year ended up changing the franchise forever because San Antonio was so bad they landed near the top of the draft lottery and eventually won the number one pick. With it, they selected Tim Duncan and the turnaround happened almost immediately. In Duncan's rookie season, the Spurs jumped from 20 wins to 56 and made the playoffs. They didn't win it all that year, but the next season was completely different. The 1999 season was shortened to 50 games because of a lockout, and San Antonio started just 6-14. But then they went on a ridiculous run, winning 31 of their final 36 games and finishing with the best record in the league. In the playoffs, Duncan and David Robinson, known as the Twin Towers, dominated. The Spurs swept both the Lakers and Trail Blazers, then beat the Knicks in the finals. Just two years after winning only 20 games, San Antonio became NBA champions with Tim Duncan taking home Finals MVP.
